title: SC-NeuroCore: Universal Stochastic Computing Framework for Neuromorphic Hardware
description: A high-performance neuromorphic computing framework combining stochastic computing with spiking neural networks. Features a Rust SIMD engine with PyO3 Python bindings, hyper-dimensional computing (HDC/VSA), Petri net simulation, HDL generation for FPGA deployment, and SCPN integration for consciousness-layer modelling.
notes: Part of the SCPN (Self-Consistent Phenomenological Network) research framework by ANULUM. Published on Zenodo and Academia.edu.
